notablePrerequisites:
Bear Umbra attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
description:
Declare Weaver of Harmony as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Weaver of Hamony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying the Weaver of Harmony trigger from step 1.
Resolve the copy of the Weaver of Harmony trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 2.
